candidates.name: Pea-Green Textured Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The texture is credible for Casual or Travel, but the actual muted-khaki color, long open overshirt body, large flap pocket and visible base T-shirt do not prove a self-contained Premium Summer Office garment.

candidates.name: Pink Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The pink is lively, but the distressed plaid, frayed raw edges, dropped shoulder and very long open body read Festival grunge rather than Premium Office.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Long-Sleeve Button-Down
candidates.decisionReason: The color is fresh, but the hanger-only open-over-tee composition provides no shoulder, torso, sleeve or hem proof and no Premium textile evidence.

candidates.name: Khaki Mock-Neck Short-Sleeve Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The flat product image offers no worn fit or drape proof, and the narrow ribbed sleeve openings, long tapered torso and muted color risk a fitted dated mass-market knit.

candidates.name: White Mock-Neck Short-Sleeve Top
candidates.decisionReason: This is a plain product-only T-shirt body with an unproven mock collar and no visible fine-gauge texture, fit or Premium fiber proof.

candidates.name: White Short-Sleeve Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The lightweight shirt can serve Resort or Casual, but the hanger-only open-over-tee view and soft band collar cannot establish Premium Office fit, drape or finish.

candidates.name: Light-Green Casual Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only source lacks fit proof, while asymmetric utility pockets, dark buttons and a visible wordmark patch make the shirt too technical and cluttered for Premium Office.

candidates.name: Pastel-Blue Clean Chino Short
candidates.decisionReason: The pastel blue is useful, but the shiny product-only image, elastic side waist, rolled hem and narrow conventional shape do not prove a Premium tailored Bermuda.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Cotton-Linen Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The gathered elastic waist, exposed drawstring, crinkled fabric and barefoot source read lounge or Resort, with no clean shoe break or Premium tailoring proof.

candidates.name: Gray Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The controlled leg is outweighed by a fully gathered waist, oversized drawcord, black D-ring, synthetic sheen and missing shoe-break evidence.

candidates.name: Navy Lightweight Relaxed-Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The dark technical trouser is broad enough to puddle over sneakers and includes a visible zip detail; it lacks the airy precise Premium Summer line.

candidates.name: Camel Relaxed-Straight Cotton Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The camel cotton works for Spring or Fall Casual, but the long leg stacks at a chunky sneaker and the garment lacks the light Premium Summer drape required here.

candidates.name: Khaki Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The light texture could serve Resort, but the wrinkled product-only image, rolled long hem and absent rise or thigh proof cannot support a Premium Office hold.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Toile Knee-Length Short
candidates.decisionReason: The controlled line and blue botanical print are useful for Resort or a daytime Party, but the all-over toile and casual sneaker styling are not Premium Office.

candidates.name: Sage Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only technical short has an integrated webbing belt, exposed zips and diagonal seams without worn fit proof, so it cannot serve as Premium tailored Bermuda.
